Based on the information ApplySmart can assess, Sunderland is a realistic university choice for your application. Sunderland also uses an assessed Interview Selection Tool (IST), based on work or caregiving experience and reflective responses, to shortlist applicants for interview. As the university does not publish the IST scoring methodology and ApplySmart cannot evaluate your IST submission, your final interview competitiveness will also depend on the quality of this assessment.
